**What I found**

Don't add the `StorageProvider` interface (the record calls this DROP). It would have one implementation, and nobody has named a second one. That means the switch it prepares for has no real scenario behind it, so its cost and value never needed scoring.

**Why it matters**

If you add it, you take on an extra layer and ongoing upkeep for a need that doesn't exist. If you skip it, you can still write the interface when a second store is actually planned, with that store's real requirements to shape it.

**Do this first**

1. Keep calling the S3 client directly, and record this rejection and its reason in the ticket or PR that proposed the interface, if there is one.

**What I did not check**

This workspace has no application code, so I couldn't inspect your S3 client. This decision rests on your statement that S3 is the only store and no other is planned. To confirm the single store, run `rg -n "S3Client|aws-sdk|boto3|GoogleCloudStorage|BlobServiceClient" <app-repo>` in the application repo.

